hero.label: EDUCATIONAL PLATFORM
hero.text: Lessons, quizzes and an AI tutor in Kazakh and Russian. Teachers create their own courses and track progress. Works even on a slow connection.

short.label: IN SHORT
short.title: WHAT IS SYNTARA
short.text: Syntara is subjects with lessons and quizzes, an AI tutor that explains topics in simple words, and a class where the teacher sees students' progress. The interface and lessons are in Kazakh, Russian and English.

demo.label: NO SIGN-UP
demo.title: ANSWER A QUESTION FROM A REAL LESSON
demo.text: This is the same question a student sees in the quiz. Pick an answer and get an explanation right away.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: We want a good explanation of every topic to be available to every student, wherever they live.
mission.quote: Where a child was born should not decide what education they get.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.inequality: Educational inequality in Kazakhstan: students' opportunities depend heavily on their school and region.
problem.pisa: PISA results below the OECD average.
problem.urbanRural: A gap between urban and rural schools.
problem.kazakhContent: A shortage of quality learning content in Kazakh.
problem.cost: The high cost of educational services for families.

audience.title: Who Syntara is for
audience.studentText: Clear lessons, quizzes with explanations and an AI tutor.
audience.teacherText: Creating courses, assigning tasks and class analytics.
audience.schoolText: One system for the gradebook, diary and homework.

why.title: Why Syntara
why.accessText: Trial access for schools — on connection terms.
why.kazakhText: Materials written in Kazakh, not machine-translated.
why.everywhereText: On an ordinary phone and with slow internet.
why.aiText: The AI tutor answers questions about the lesson topic.

how.title: How it works

platform.question: What is this platform?
platform.answer: Syntara is a learning platform: lessons, quizzes and an AI tutor in Kazakh and Russian.

start.question: Where do I start learning?
start.answer: Open «Subjects» and choose a subject. To save your results, sign in or join a class.

language.question: How do I change the language?
language.answer: Click the language switcher in the top bar.

registration.question: Do I need to register?
registration.answer: Not to browse the site and try a question. Signing in is needed to save progress.

hero.title: A school gradebook that leads to the textbook
hero.text: The gradebook, diary and homework are linked to Syntara lessons and quizzes.

gets.reportCardText: Final grades for the term and the year.

diff.devices: Works on ordinary phones and slow internet.
